title: Supertext plugin version report, v1
description: Body of POST /api/v1/report. Sent by a Supertext plugin when its settings are saved and when its own, the system's or the runtime's version changed. See docs/DEVELOPER.md → Report protocol.

event.description: Why the report is sent: installed, settings_saved, upgraded (plugin, system or runtime version changed since the last report), api_key_check (the API key check result changed outside a settings save, e.g. a new key from the environment or a translation rejected with 401) or check (sent by a command or test). Other values are stored as given.

site_url.description: Base URL of the installation (the site or back end the plugin runs in). It identifies the installation; the center normalizes it (see site-url-vectors.json).

name.description: The plugin's GitHub repository name, e.g. Typo3-Supertext-Translation.

version.description: The version from the plugin's official version source (see plugin-conventions → Releases).

system.description: The host system: CMS, PIM, shop or application.

runtime.description: The language runtime the plugin runs on, e.g. PHP 8.3.12, Node.js 22.11.0, Python 3.12.7, .NET 9.0.0, Java 21.0.4.

sdk_version.description: Version of the bundled Supertext SDK, if any.

api_key_configured.description: Whether a Supertext API key is set. Never the key itself.

callback.description: The plugin's public ping endpoint. The center calls GET <url>?challenge=<c> to see whether the installation is reachable from the internet (spec/callback-vectors.json). Must be on the site's host or a subdomain of it. Omit it where the plugin has no public endpoint (hosted apps) or reporting is off.

api_key_check.description: Result of the plugin's latest automatic API key check (cost-free GET features against the Supertext API). Never the key itself.

status.description: ok: Supertext accepted the key. invalid: Supertext rejected it (HTTP 401/403). missing: no key is set. unreachable: Supertext couldn't be reached (network error, timeout, HTTP 5xx). error: any other answer (http_status says which). Other values are stored as given.

checked_at.description: When the check ran (ISO 8601 with time zone). Missing: the center uses the time it received the report.

http_status.description: HTTP status Supertext answered with, if any.

error_code.description: Supertext's error code from the response body, if any (e.g. INVALID_API_KEY).
